classification: transparent postexecution repair of an offline replay schema bug; no scientific design, GPU computation, formal result, or raw audit artifact is changed

completed_formal_attempt_b.immutability_rule: The formal result and every raw/audit byte bound by the 13-entry ledger are inputs to replay v2 and must not be edited, regenerated, renamed, or replaced.

first_offline_replay_failure.classification: offline verifier implementation failure after a complete formal run; not a failed live receipt and not a reason to rerun the GPU computation

root_cause.runner_record: The runner stores verify_request_gdn_binding_guard's raw pointer-free witness under live_receipts.request_gdn. Its legal fields are guard_id, capture_id, policy, layer_indices, state_index, resident_count, completed_request_indices, expected_tensor_count_per_owner, rows, and rows_sha256.
root_cause.derived_summary: rebound_tensor_count is not a raw witness field. It is derived by offline witness replay as len(completed_request_indices) multiplied by expected_tensor_count_per_owner.
root_cause.old_replay_bug: The old replay read the raw witness but directly required request_gdn.rebound_tensor_count == 60, so it rejected every legal raw witness that correctly omitted that derived field.
root_cause.test_gap: The old fake receipt incorrectly inserted completed_request_indices and rebound_tensor_count as if request_gdn were already a derived summary; it therefore masked the raw-versus-derived schema mismatch.

replay_source.change: Add a candidate-import-free raw request-GDN witness replay that checks exact record and row schema, canonical 30-layer geometry, row cardinality and coordinate order, lowercase SHA-256 token syntax and legal rebound/unchanged token relations, and a full canonical rows_sha256 recomputation; then derive rebound_tensor_count and require the frozen one-resident/one-completed/60-rebound contract.

focused_test_source.change: Replace the impossible derived-summary fixture with the exact raw witness shape and add fail-closed digest, coordinate-order, storage-token, malformed-token, and extra-schema-field tamper tests plus a candidate-import-free static gate.

offline_launcher.change: New replay-only launcher binds the immutable design/runner/formal result/log/pre-replay ledger and repaired replay/test hashes, hides all GPUs, preserves the failed replay logs, and writes only v2-named replay/log/stage/ledger files.

outcome_disclosure.disposition: The repair must be applied to the one immutable completed formal result regardless of whether its numeric overhead is favorable, unfavorable, or counterintuitive.

replay_v2_execution_contract.failure_policy: Preserve any replay-v2 pass or failure and its logs. A replay-v2 failure does not authorize a GPU rerun or modification of the formal inputs.
